name: Clear Networks
summary: Melbourne NBN fibre/fixed-wireless + satellite (Sky Muster, IPSTAR) ISP (Clear Networks Pty Ltd, sister co. of Day3 via acquisition of Canberra's RBBS); acquired by SkyMesh 2022; brand continued as SkyMesh 'Clear Broadband'; infrastructure sold to Summit Internet 2023.

events.details: Clear Networks Pty Ltd founded Melbourne.
